description: Priority (High / Medium / Low) of each AI RMF subcategory in the AI RMF profile XLS (its Priority column), from the AI system inventory (GOVERN 1.6, question_rules.json ai_system_inventory). Applied by scripts/ai_priority.py for the Stage 2 writer; it never changes which questions are asked. Decided 2026-11-02 (AI_RMF_Mapping_Sheet_Design.md section 4).
band_levels_note: One level per band, in the order of the bands in question_rules.json ai_system_inventory.criticality. A system's criticality is the highest level among its answers.
blank_note: A band left blank, a client AI area no inventory system is marked with, or no inventory at all counts as High: not being able to answer is itself a gap.

domain_floor.note: Loss of life is possible in these domains: a subcategory reached through a row with a people impact, and MEASURE 2.6 (safety), are always High.

foundation: A foundation subcategory (all of GOVERN and mapping_rules.json foundation.subcategories) is organisation-wide: the highest criticality of any system.
areas: Any other subcategory: the highest criticality among the systems marked with an AI area whose mapping row (or a row that folds it) reaches the subcategory. Subcategories not in the client's questionnaire get no priority.
